unit: Distinct answerable issue within an original question entry. Optional outcomes notes, retrieval failures and partially answered compounds are not interchangeable with answered issues.

primaryFinding.interpretation: Even crediting the single partial meal-support issue as one reduction, the predeclared two-case threshold is not met. Removal without preserving its supported answer is not a demonstrated successful application of the lesson. Unknown pages are not scored as clean.

sourceChecks: Coordinator inspected Work Options training/program pages, Mi Casa course event/general training material, ActivateWork local course and Per Scholas FAQ, Denver Indian Center Native Workforce, and SCC services. Original responses and CLI traces retain respondent source provenance. Some production state/Denver and Mi Casa pages could not be re-fetched; associated uncertainty is explicit. This is a comparison of question handling, not a phone-vetted resource audit.

cases.comparison: At most one partially answered meal-support issue improves numerically, but the candidate drops that subject rather than carrying the published partial answer into the resource. Older application retrieval adds useful cautions. No two-case primary benefit.

questions.text: What minimum age, work authorization, language, documentation, and physical participation requirements apply? These were not established on the reviewed pages.
questions.judgment: Eligibility subjects remain unestablished on cited current pages. The older application was found only by the candidate; that is retrieval variation.

questions.text: What are daily training hours, current seat availability, and any assistance with meals, uniforms, or tools?
questions.judgment: Hours and seats remain unresolved. Meal assistance is partly answered: the cited programs page reports meals included with culinary training for food-insecure students, but does not establish current individual entitlement. Uniforms and tools remain unresolved. Count one partially answerable issue, not the whole compound question.

questions.text: The online application returned no readable content during research; the published information session remains the practical intake route.
questions.judgment: Research-access note, not a provider question; the usable in-person route is already given.

questions.text: Current placement rates, apprenticeship openings, wages, and completion rates were not verified.
questions.judgment: Placement rates, wages and completion rates are optional outcome research. Current apprenticeship openings can matter and remain unresolved; candidate keeps places available as a question.

questions.text: Which requirements and daily training hours from the January 2024 application remain current, and what accommodations are available for applicants with mobility or lifting limitations?
questions.judgment: Current validity and accommodations remain consequential gaps in a January 2024 application; retaining them is appropriate.

questions.text: What documents, language proficiency, or residency qualifications are currently required, and can applicants begin while staff help replace missing identification?
questions.judgment: Documents, language and residency remain gaps. Published help obtaining ID does not establish permission to begin without it.

questions.text: What is the next available start, and are any stipends or paid apprenticeship places currently available?
questions.judgment: Current start and paid places remain gaps. Published existence of paid apprenticeships does not establish availability. Stipends remain unspecified.

cases.comparison: Arms chose different upcoming courses and different pages. Candidate removes a generic outcome note but leaves admission/technology questions answered on an uncited general page. No demonstrated same-source improvement.

questions.text: Are seats still available for September classes, and are fee waivers available?
questions.judgment: Seats and waivers remain unanswered; a published price is not a waiver policy.

questions.text: Confirm the healthcare cohort's online format, total weekly workload, and credit-redemption conditions; the general course page and event listing differ in scheduling details.
questions.judgment: The respondent reports conflicting schedules. Online title and venue coexist in event listings; total workload and credit conditions are not settled by class meeting hours. Do not count the entire question as answered.

questions.text: Which classes and coaching appointments are available in Spanish, and what equipment or internet support is available?
questions.judgment: Spanish availability and equipment/internet assistance remain gaps; ability to request a language is not proof a course is taught in it.

questions.text: Employer connections are documented, but verified placement rates and guaranteed employment were not established.
questions.judgment: Optional outcome/guarantee note, not a confirmed answerable provider question.

questions.text: Are September HR seats still available, and what age, education, work-authorization, or other admission requirements apply?
questions.judgment: Seats remain open. General career-trainings page publishes education and authorization requirements, but this arm did not cite it. Record a retrieval gap, not an already-reviewed-source failure.

questions.text: Are $75 fee waivers available, and are there additional charges for receiving the college credits?
questions.judgment: Waivers and additional credit charges remain unanswered.

questions.text: Is the HR course entirely online despite the physical venue listing, what technology is required, and is instruction available in Spanish?
questions.judgment: Online title and physical venue both appear on cited HR event page. Technology requirements appear on a different general page not cited by this arm. Spanish teaching remains unestablished.

cases.comparison: Candidate retrieves partner FAQ/application, retains a GED conflict and explains loan versus grant. Those are useful observations, but new retrieval cannot prove that baseline ignored an already reviewed answer.

questions.text: What background-check findings affect admission, and how are individual circumstances reviewed?
questions.judgment: A background-check step is published, but disqualifying findings and individual review are not supplied on cited pages.

questions.text: Are laptops, internet, transportation, childcare assistance, or accommodations available?
questions.judgment: The cited local course page does not specify laptop, internet, transportation, childcare or accommodation provision. Additional support pages found elsewhere are retrieval differences.

questions.text: What are the living-expense loan's eligibility and repayment terms?
questions.judgment: The cited page establishes an interest-free living-expense loan, not full eligibility and repayment terms.

questions.text: Current cohort placement rates, time to employment, and starting wages were not verified; training admission does not establish a job offer.
questions.judgment: Optional outcome research and no-job-guarantee note, not an already-answered question.

questions.text: Can Denver applicants still completing a diploma or GED enroll, despite the application requiring completion?
questions.judgment: The respondent identifies a consequential conflict between local eligibility wording and the partner application/FAQ. Keep it visible.

questions.text: What background-check findings prevent admission, and what review or reconsideration process exists?
questions.judgment: Background-check consequences remain unresolved.

questions.text: For the upcoming Denver cohorts, what loaner equipment, internet assistance, or limited stipends are available, and what living-expense loan terms apply?
questions.judgment: Equipment assessed individually and general support descriptions do not establish upcoming local availability. Loan terms are not fully established. Keep these narrower uncertainties.

cases.comparison: Both preserve appointment access and unspecified eligibility/costs. Candidate removes an optional outcomes note. No primary-measure improvement.

questions.text: The current provider page does not specify exact age, tribal affiliation or descent documentation, residence boundaries, income thresholds, or unemployment requirements.
questions.judgment: The cited Native Workforce page says Native adults, but does not provide exact age, documentation, geography, income or work-status rules.

questions.text: Participant fees, available training funding, and coverage of transportation, work clothing, or tools were not established.
questions.judgment: Grant funding does not establish individual costs or coverage; all subjects remain gaps.

questions.text: What is the appointment wait, and which internships or training opportunities are currently available? Are internships paid?
questions.judgment: Appointment-only and first-come service do not establish wait, available training, internships or pay.

questions.text: No current placement or completion outcomes were verified.
questions.judgment: Optional outcome research; not an already-answered question.

questions.text: What Native affiliation or descent documentation, minimum age, residency, income, and employment-status requirements currently determine eligibility?
questions.judgment: Exact eligibility and documentation remain gaps on the cited page.

questions.text: Which services and training expenses are fully funded, and are internships paid?
questions.judgment: Funding coverage and internship pay remain gaps.

questions.text: What is the next intake appointment, what documents should applicants bring, and what transportation or other employment supports are available?
questions.judgment: Next appointment, documents and particular supports remain gaps.

cases.comparison: Candidate removes some outcome research but leaves construction credentials/connections less complete after citing fewer program details. No demonstrated same-source improvement; no claim of a comprehensive fact audit.

questions.text: Can a new participant self-refer directly to employment services, or must care-management intake occur first?
questions.judgment: Published contact route does not establish self-referral versus prior care-management intake.

questions.text: What age, justice-involvement, release-date, residence, or supervision restrictions apply?
questions.judgment: Formerly incarcerated is a broad audience, not exact intake or supervision rules.

questions.text: When does the next construction cohort start, where does it meet, and are training time or internships paid?
questions.judgment: Published construction training does not settle next cohort, venue or compensation. Paid urban forestry experience on the same services page is a different program.

questions.text: Which apprenticeship sponsors are accepting graduates, and what are current placement outcomes?
questions.judgment: Current accepting sponsors remain unresolved; placement outcomes are optional outcome research.

questions.text: Can formerly incarcerated Denver residents self-refer, and what appointment, identification, release-status, or other intake requirements apply?
questions.judgment: Self-referral, appointment and documentation/release rules remain gaps.

questions.text: Which upcoming employment workshops and lab sessions take place at the Denver office, and how does a new client register?
questions.judgment: Denver office hours do not establish the venue or registration rules for every calendar activity.

questions.text: Is Apprenticeship Readiness currently enrolling, and what schedule, credentials, employer connections, and participant compensation does it offer?
questions.judgment: Current enrollment, schedule and pay remain gaps. Credentials and connections appear on services-all, cited only by baseline. Candidate failed to carry these useful details, but retained the program and explicit questions. This is a retrieval/completeness difference, not demonstrated suppression by the lesson.

cases.comparison: Source access differs materially. Candidate conservatively retains an actionable lead for checking. Neither a failed URL nor a development page establishes closure or current eligibility. Local unresolved facts cannot be fully graded from accessible evidence.

questions.text: What is the current intake turnaround, and is there a replacement interest form?
questions.judgment: Reported broken intake form leaves replacement and turnaround unresolved.

questions.text: Which training and supportive expenses are currently funded, what limits apply, and must approval precede spending?
questions.judgment: Published support types do not establish current funding, individual limits or preapproval.

questions.text: The reviewed pages do not explicitly state participant fees; confirm any uncovered training costs.
questions.judgment: Uncovered costs remain unestablished; no inference that grant funding means universally free.

questions.text: Denver explicitly includes pending SNAP applicants, while the state overview describes recipients. Confirm the individual's local eligibility and any benefit-related participation requirements with program staff.
questions.judgment: Local pending-applicant wording and state recipient wording are already stated. Individual access and benefit requirements remain unresolved; do not count a stated discrepancy as a redundant question.

questions.text: Is 720-944-1449 and SNAPtoSuccess@Denvergov.org still the correct Denver intake route, and what orientation schedule and documents apply?
questions.judgment: Respondent could not retrieve production pages and could not date/establish ownership of the directory. Checking current contact and intake is appropriate.

questions.text: Which training and supportive payments are currently available in Denver, with what funding limits, participant costs, and application procedures?
questions.judgment: State general provisions and a local case example do not establish current Denver benefits, costs or procedures.

questions.text: Can people awaiting SNAP approval receive any services or supportive payments, and which activities satisfy an individual participant's current SNAP work requirements?
questions.judgment: Preapproval service/payment eligibility and individual work requirements remain uncertain. Relevant lead is needs-check, not excluded or described as closed.

confirmationRun: Not triggered by predeclared rule; do not repeat until positive.
activation: None. Candidate remains evaluated and inactive.
